rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a physical mountain or large hill.

example.english: This mountain is pretty high; it takes a whole hour to walk up.
example.traditional: 呢座山幾高，行上去要成個鐘。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 saan1 gei2 gou1 haang4 soeng5 heoi3 jiu3 seng4 go3 zung1

rows.note: Use this for a huge heap or quantity, rather than for a literal landform.

example.english: I've got a huge mountain of documents on my desk, and I don't know which one to start with.
example.traditional: 我張枱有一大堆文件，完全唔知由邊份開始。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 toi2 jau5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 man4 gin6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 jau4 bin1 fan6 hoi1 ci2
